title: Chrome on My Tongue
style: Hip-hop pop with swaggering halftime bounce and pocketed snares; verse rides a sparse bassline and clipped guitar stabs, pre-chorus tightens with rising handclaps, chorus opens with stacked gang vocals and a punchy synth hook. Lead vocal stays close-mic and cocky, with doubled phrases, ad-lib tails, and short delay throws on key words. Riser lifts, record-stop hits, and a siren swell mark transitions. Bright, glossy, and chest-thumping mix.
